app_fee.value: Application fee is $70 for most programs, for domestic and international applicants.
app_fee.quote: For most programs, the application fee is $70 for domestic and international students.

fee_waiver.value: Graduate School waivers need one of a short list of criteria (recruitment programs, some memberships); several waiver types are for US citizens and permanent residents only.
fee_waiver.quote: IU Bloomington applicants must meet at least ONE of the following criteria to be eligible for an application fee waiver | these waivers are available for U.S. citizens and permanent residents only

gre_general.value: Set by each department; see the program records.

toefl_min.value: IU Bloomington campus-wide international admissions minimum is TOEFL iBT 79; individual departments may require higher.

ielts_min.value: IU Bloomington campus-wide international admissions minimum is IELTS Academic 6.5; individual departments may require higher.

english_waiver.value: Each department decides: it may require TOEFL from non-native speakers regardless of where they studied, so an English-medium Indian degree is not an automatic waiver. Ask the department.
english_waiver.quote: If your native language is not English, your department may require you to submit results for the TOEFL exam, regardless of where you were educated.

notes: Departments set their own deadlines and English minimums. Luddy, Biology, Psychology and the School of Medicine also have their own pages.
